forecasting.neural_aggregate: decode each calibration mu on target ABP then average outputs
forecasting.TFA: 100 point periodic Fourier synthesis; target ABP unwindowed/demeaned; DC=calibration CBFV mean; real Nyquist

clinical.side_policy: controls: average left and right; stroke: symptom-ipsilateral side only; input side selection must be curated before inference
clinical.inference: per-window mu -> spectra-averaged probe curve -> side -> visit -> person
clinical.classifier_order: visit frequency curve -> visit bands -> merge visits -> LOPO
clinical.imputation: training-fold G/C medians; P circular mean; drop all-missing/undefined columns in that fold
clinical.coherence: v2: no additive offset; invalid PSD -> NaN
clinical.identity_policy: person_ids must merge repeated visits before leave-one-person-out classification

statistics.AUC_unit: paired class-stratified people, fixed OOF, no refitting
statistics.AUC_significance: two-sided Holm p<.05 within declared family
statistics.missing_comparison: retain planned family size; uncomputable p remains NA

tfa.latent_aggregation: decode each window mu separately, then aggregate curves within side
tfa.spectral_aggregation: five probe-window spectra averaged before H/G/P/C; traditional all real windows per side
tfa.gain: relative output/input; standardized display derived by common scale conversion
tfa.missing_curve_aggregation: strict arithmetic/circular aggregation; invalid values propagate to fold-only imputation
